meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为对话机器人装上长期记忆,支持本地或远程两种运行方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 助手记住跨会话的上下文却不知怎么搭记忆服务
copy.tagline_en: Give your chatbot long-term memory, run locally or remotely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to recall context across sessions but need help wiring up memory.

howto.what: 装上后在 Grok Bot 上运行本地 worker 与 CMEM Pro 观察器,每个 agent 有转录监视;任务开始时注入 session_start_context,并把实时索引写入 agent 的记忆日志文件。不依赖 Cursor。
howto.when: 在 Grok Bot 上安装或配置 claude-mem 时触发;默认走本地 worker + CMEM Pro 观察器,可选 host 登录观察器或远程 cmem.ai。

say.text: 帮我装 claude-mem,ide 选 grok-bot
say.note: 默认装本地 worker 与 CMEM Pro 观察器
只在你明确要回环 shim 时才用

howto.what_en: After install, Grok Bot runs a local worker plus the CMEM Pro observer, with a transcript watcher per agent. At the start of a real task it injects session_start_context and writes a live index into the agent memory log. No Cursor needed.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: default local worker with CMEM Pro observer, optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

say_en.note: Defaults to local worker plus CMEM Pro observer
